In the distance, a second Corgi lies down quietly near some distant trees. The background features several tall, green deciduous trees under a cloudy, overcast sky. (2) The camera moves closer to the running Corgi, which looks toward the lens with its mouth open, panting from exertion. The dog’s short legs move quickly through the thick layers of dry grass, and its white chest fur is prominent against the brownish-gold ground. (3) The dog continues its trot toward the edge of the field where several large, mature trees stand. Beyond the trees, a paved road is visible with several white parked cars and yellow traffic bollards along the roadside. (4) Reaching a patch of thicker grass under the shade of a large tree, the Corgi stops and lowers its head to sniff and bite at the freshly mowed vegetation. The lighting is soft and diffused due to the overcast weather conditions. (5) The camera pans to the right, showing a different part of the open park area. Another dog can be seen in the far distance near a fence, and the perimeter of the park is defined by a mix of trees and utility poles.
